dct_creator_sm: Environics Institute for Survey Research (Environics Research Group, Toronto, ON).
dct_description_sm: There were 2 Focus Canada surveys conducted in 2018: Fall 2018 - Canadian public opinion on immigration, refugees and the USA and Winter 2018 - Canadian public opinion on immigration and minority groups. This dataset only refers to the Winter 2018 Focus Canada survey.

The Focus Canada National Survey is a national public opinion survey to take the pulse of Canadians on a wide range of relevant policy areas and issues facing the country at this time. As part of its Focus Canada public opinion research program, the Environics Institute partnered with the Canadian Race Relations Foundation to update its ongoing research on Canadian attitudes about immigration and multiculturalism.
